meta.title: What is Vietnamese Coffee ( & How to Make it)
meta.description:
In a world that celebrates speed, phin drip coffee taught me the importance of slowing down. In this video, I'll be sharing the story, history, and recipes for Vietnamese coffee. I hope you guys enjoy!

- Annie

Time Stamps:
0:00 Intro
0:27 My Story
0:45 History
2:19 How to Brew Vietnamese Coffee
6:05 Bac Xiu
6:53 Caphe Muoi
7:59 Outro

comments.author: @NguyenTuanPhan
comments.text: Vietnamese dripped coffee or café fin is almost a lost art nowadays.  I remember growing up in the early 70's, the fun was watching each drop of coffee drip into the glass and it used to take time, 10-15 minutes until all the good part is extracted while the conversation, the thinking, the poem writing started. Now, going the coffee shop and most of the time you are handed a pre-made coffee and who knows when it was " dripped".
